answers.reason: The faculty administrative officer is not a member of the senate based on the described roles.
The budget planning round is managed by higher rank office holders and central administration.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, a task outside the faculty administrative officer's duties.
The faculty council decides faculty affairs, but only the dean is listed as chairing and representing it.
The study commission prepares changes to degree programmes and advises the faculty council, not involving the administrative officer.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations, timetables and records for the faculty.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects, handled by researchers and leadership.
The module revision working group rewrites module descriptions, which is not part of the administrative officer's tasks.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the organizational duties of the faculty administrative officer.
Orientation week planning is for planning the first week for new students, not an administrative officer duty.
